title: Founder Runtime Store Live Admission Execution Contract
goal: Define the store live admission execution contract and safety boundary before any governed DB-backed or live execution behavior is added.
safetyRules: Do not create DB schemas, run migrations, read or write DB/runtime records, persist requests, execute CRUD, capture approvals, accept handoff, grant authority, unlock execution, call providers/models, dispatch agents, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not expose raw JSON, raw logs, raw policy dumps, raw table names, raw report paths, private IDs, or fake runnable actions in primary UX.
reuseCheck: Reuse P131.5 scoped Command Center UX evidence.
Do not duplicate report writers, checker formatters, mode guards, redaction helpers, route matrices, status helpers, UI components, or evidence/audit/activity appenders.
commandCenterUx: P132.1 does not change dashboard source. The P131.5 scoped Store Live Admission Scope cards remain visible only on Business Build and Agent Flow. Chat with NEXUS and Lite stay clean.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, DB writes, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.
